physics: MCsquare e0404: Class II condensed history, ICRU-63-type nuclear cross sections; nuclear interactions and secondary protons/deuterons/alphas enabled; E_Cut_Pro 0.5 MeV, D_Max 0.2 cm, Epsilon_Max 0.25
source: Single spot, nominal 150 MeV; BDL_mono.txt uses the verbatim default-BDL layout (BDL_default_DN.txt header) with rows for 140/150/160 MeV: EnergySpread 0 %, SpotSize 1.0 mm, Divergence 1e-6 rad, Correlation 0 for both axes and Gaussians, Weight1 1, Weight2 0, ProtonsMU 1e9. SpotSize is the standard deviation (sigma) in mm and Divergence the sigma in rad: src/compute_beam_model.c builds the covariance matrix [[s^2, c*s*d],[c*s*d, d^2]] and samples with sqrt(eigenvalues) as sigmas (positions mm, converted to cm). Smaller sizes (0.001 mm, or 0.5 mm with 1e-3 rad) combined with correlation 0 made all primaries 'generated outside' in diagnostics (see README), so 1.0 mm is the smallest verified working size; the beam is therefore NOT point-like (sigma 1 mm). Gantry 0, couch 0, spot (0,0), meterset 1; isocentre (60,150,60) mm = CT centre.
geometry: CT 60 x 600 x 60 voxels with ANISOTROPIC spacing 2 x 0.5 x 2 mm (120 x 300 x 120 mm; depth axis y, 0.5 mm depth bins), all voxels HU 0; dose grid = CT grid. Anisotropic ElementSpacing support in MCsquare e0404 is not verified: if the run fails or the dose grid is rescaled, fall back to 1 mm isotropic. Isocentre (60,150,60) mm = CT centre (y extent 600 x 0.5 mm = 300 mm), same convention as the 2 mm case. For gantry 0 the beam enters at the y_max face (y = 300 mm) and travels in -y, so depth = (y_max - y).
materials: HU 0 -> Water_Phantom scanner conversion of the registered MCsquare (HU_Density/HU_Material files)
cuts: E_Cut_Pro 0.5 MeV, D_Max 0.2 cm, Epsilon_Max 0.25, Te_Min 0.05 MeV
scorers: LET_MHD_Output True, LET method left at the MCsquare default (StopPow)
units: MetaImage float32 little-endian, x fastest, spacing 2 x 0.5 x 2 mm, y reversed with respect to depth. Dose.mhd is dose per delivered proton (src/compute_scoring.c PostProcess_Scoring: dose * plan normalization(1.0) / simulated primaries / voxel volume), NOT scaled by the meterset or ProtonsMU; MCsquare converts to Gy only for DVH via DoseScaling = 1.602176e-19 * 1000 * Num_delivered_protons (src/compute_simulation.c), implying the file unit is eV/g per proton (inferred; check magnitude against a known peak dose). LET in MeV/cm as per the MCsquare StopPow method (to verify from header/doc); RNG_Seed in config.txt is the per-batch seed (varied by the orchestrator)
rationale: independent Monte Carlo evidence for suite S-PHYS-PROTON-EM/-NUCLEAR/-LET: evidence-grade candidate (0.5 mm depth bins, 1e5 primaries per batch; multiple seeds required for batch variance)
